notable_absence.finding: Like its Capella twin, this page offers four equally-weighted, platform-neutral ways to create a test document with an expiry (SQL++ UPSERT, cbc, Python SDK, Java SDK) with no Capella-specific or Server-specific framing distinguishing them - the only Server-specific detail is that the cbc paths given (/opt/couchbase/bin/cbc, the macOS .app bundle path, and C:\Program Files\Couchbase\Server\bin\cbc) are directly usable on the machine running this documentation's own product, unlike on the Capella twin where they describe a different machine's filesystem entirely.

cross_product_finding: This page cites the identical macOS defect and Jira ticket as its 'Delete v Expiry' sibling and the Capella twin: 'On macOS (or OS-X) if you get a 'dyld: Library not loaded' when running _cbc_ a solution is documented in [MB-37768](https://issues.couchbase.com/browse/MB-37768).' Combined with the classic-role requirement (Full Admin / Eventing Full Admin via Function Scope) that recurs on every worked-example page in this batch and is absent from every Capella twin, this reinforces that the prerequisite/setup sections of these paired pages are shared boilerplate lightly retitled per product, while the access-control framing is genuinely product-specific.
